scenarios.title: In an owned disposable Markdown file, native IME composition does not trigger slash or document-link completion; after composition, allowed [[ completion inserts the exact selected target/label. Toggle-heading and nested-details edits survive Source/Rich switches. Copy context and link-copy use the actual macOS clipboard without changing another document. Preserve the independently blocked Finder-source-path scenario; never infer native dropped identity.

Use only a run-owned readable Markdown file with effective macOS ACL write denial. The editor shows the advisory disk restriction independently of format read-only; draft edits and local annotations remain possible. Save denial preserves exact disk, draft and dirty state. Removing only the run-created ACL and retrying saves with the normal disk precondition. Restore/delete all owned ACL fixtures; never modify user files or globally change permissions.

With a run-owned Git worktree, edit-tab Changes retains the same buffer/tab; single/double/Alt-Option-open from Source Control produces preview/permanent/right-split diff placement while Cmd/Shift selection remains reachable. Native focus and F7/Shift-F7 and Cmd+S operate only on the focused editable modified side, not a neighboring terminal or read-only staged/branch/commit pane. Markdown modified-only preview is explicit and returning to source keeps the draft and split selection.

In a run-owned workspace with Pinned, nested project groups and several projects, scroll through actual sticky headers and toggle Sidebar section separators. Dividers never appear at the first, host-adjacent, active sticky or nested boundary, and changing the setting does not shift row bounds or drag hit targets. Restart the owned app and confirm the preference survives. A collapsed Pinned header is not representable in the current renderer and must not be claimed exercised.
